title: How To Improve Your Success Through Imagination 🤯
html:
Many people lead rather boring lives and remain in that state for most of their lives because they don't know how to use their imagination.

You can stifle yourself not by your lack of knowledge but by not taking the time to imagine great things happening in your life.

You only need a minute.

I've been guilty of this lately because I haven't felt like I have something to really focus on. Get my teeth into.

So, this a reminder that you should think about something you would like to do if you couldn't fail. The only thing holding you back is a lack of imagination, which would stimulate your thought processes.

Remember, desire and purpose create in your mind the substance of that which you wish to own, possess or experience.

Imagination and creativity are two keys to genius.

Imagination creates pictures of what you desire in your subconscious mind. It imprints mental images of their successful accomplishment.

Research has proven that the brain records imagined events as memories, indistinguishable from actual experiences. You can influence your desired achievements by mentally imprinting success images in your brain.

You can realise your goals by rehearsing what you want to happen in your mind. And then taking consistent action. Visualisation has been proven to work in sports, business, and life over and over again. I've been seriously remiss in not doing it for a long time, so this was my reminder to start it up.

This week, take a piece of paper or open a text file on your computer and ask yourself, What is it I really want to achieve? And Why do I want to achieve it? Write whatever comes to mind. You can edit it later. Turn into a story. Stories have superpowers.

When you know what you want, find some images to accompany it. Then, mentally rehearse what you want to happen by imprinting pictures of it in your subconscious mind.
